descriptions.shortDescription: CRM and sales pipeline management for Nextcloud.
descriptions.longDescription: Pipelinq is a CRM and sales pipeline management application for Nextcloud. It enables organisations to manage leads, contacts, opportunities, and sales processes within Nextcloud. Built on Open Register, it integrates with Nextcloud's ecosystem and provides a structured approach to managing customer relationships and sales workflows suitable for both government and commercial organisations. Conduction maintains this component within the Nextcloud ISV programme. Pipelinq is available in the Nextcloud App Store at https://apps.nextcloud.com/apps/pipelinq.
features: Client management for persons and organisations with contact details, notes and history
Contact persons linked to organisations with roles
Lead pipeline on a drag-and-drop kanban board with configurable stages
Request intake before requests become formal cases
Contact moments for calls, emails, visits and other interactions
My Work queue with assigned leads, requests and follow-ups
Two-way sync with Nextcloud Contacts via CardDAV
Duplicate detection through OpenRegister master data management
vCard import and export plus scheduled CSV data exports
Activity and notifications on assignments, stage changes and new notes

descriptions.longDescription: Pipelinq is een CRM- en verkooppipelinebeheertoepassing voor Nextcloud. Het stelt organisaties in staat om leads, contacten, kansen en verkoopprocessen te beheren binnen Nextcloud. Gebouwd op Open Register integreert het met het Nextcloud-ecosysteem en biedt een gestructureerde aanpak voor het beheren van klantrelaties en verkoopworkflows, geschikt voor zowel overheids- als commerciële organisaties. Conduction onderhoudt dit component binnen het Nextcloud ISV-programma. Pipelinq is beschikbaar in de Nextcloud App Store via https://apps.nextcloud.com/apps/pipelinq.
features: Klantbeheer voor personen en organisaties met contactgegevens, notities en historie
Contactpersonen gekoppeld aan organisaties met rollen
Lead-pipeline op een drag-and-drop kanbanbord met configureerbare fases
Verzoekintake voordat verzoeken formele zaken worden
Contactmomenten voor telefoongesprekken, e-mails, bezoeken en andere interacties
Mijn Werk met toegewezen leads, verzoeken en opvolgingen
Tweerichtingssynchronisatie met Nextcloud Contacten via CardDAV
Duplicaatdetectie via master-data management in OpenRegister
vCard-import en -export plus geplande CSV-data-exports
Activiteit en notificaties bij toewijzingen, fasewijzigingen en nieuwe notities

openBreaches.title: Public booking portal: wrong API base makes every call return the SPA shell as 200 — anonymous visitors see a fabricated confirmation
Move the message-box abstraction to Portaliq and rename it to English (Berichtenbox* -> consumer of Portaliq)
gate-57: WalkInQueueService::createTicket has no caller, and every invariant it enforces is bypassed in practice
gate-57: CalendarSyncService::generateVEvent and PortalSessionManager::clearMfaPending are write capabilities with no caller
E2E: NcSelect dropdown options are unclickable inside NcDialog — body-appended menu renders beneath the modal
gate-61: four post-event listeners do writes and outbound AP HTTP inside the user's write (ADR-078)
Land the KCC contact-centre extension (8 schemas) against the unified `ticket` supertype
1038 of 1175 `@spec` anchors do not resolve, and gate-46 reports PASS over all of them
Decision needed: consume-or-remove the 7 dormant capabilities behind gate-6 and gate-57
navigation-ia spec describes a left-nav removed deliberately on 2026-07-03 — all 3 scenarios unsatisfiable
Sales overview date-range pills never render: manifest omits dateRange.control = "pills" that CnDashboardPage gates on
15 findAll() call sites pass register/schema at the top level of config, where OpenRegister ignores them — SLA, POS, attribution and segmentation query the wrong context
POST /api/segments cannot create any segment: "no schema mapping configured" for a contact schema that exists — and the message names one of four possible causes
winProbability is never served: the materialise:false lead calculation is absent from every object OpenRegister returns, so the Win % column and Deal widget render empty
7 more manifest include entries name visible:false schema properties (plus 1 phantom key) — the rest of the #775 class
IDOR: four #[NoAdminRequired] loyalty endpoints trust {accountId} from the URL — one of them drains another customer's points
mfaEnroll disables an already-verified second factor before any verification — MFA downgrade from a portal session
Attaching a POS customer with marketing consent overwrites the contact with a 10-key projection — every other field is nulled
POS payment webhook answers 200 for a delivery it never processed — the provider never retries and the payment is lost
Gift cards: redeem is not idempotent (a POS retry debits twice) and activate returns 200 for a blocked card
